department: DPP-Biotech (Dual Cooperative Doctoral Program in Biotechnology)

deadline.value: No application deadline is stated on the DPP-Biotech application page.

gre_subject.value: The DPP-Biotech page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A signed agreement on doctoral studies with the supervisor is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: Signed agreement on doctoral studies with: Work plan and timetable and information on your individual qualification program

funding.value: Structured-programme students are also supported financially, per the university stipends page.
funding.quote: If they are in structured PhD programs, they are also supported financially.

entry_route.value: Admission needs a successful relevant master's programme or equivalent degree.
entry_route.quote: A successful graduation in a relevant Master's program or equivalent program in the subject area

ielts_min.value: Applicants show English at C1 level, such as IELTS 7.0, or German C1 instead.
ielts_min.quote: proof of sufficient English language skills (min. C1, e.g. proven by IELTS 7.0, equivalent to 94 or more points on the Internet-Based TOEFL test (iBT-TOEFL) or higher)

toefl_min.value: English C1 is shown by 94 or more on the internet-based TOEFL, as an alternative to German C1.
toefl_min.quote: proof of sufficient English language skills (min. C1, e.g. proven by IELTS 7.0, equivalent to 94 or more points on the Internet-Based TOEFL test (iBT-TOEFL) or higher)

notes: Dual cooperative programme with industry partners. The programme accepts German C1 (TDN4) as an alternative to English C1.
